ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor launch via --access-token credential gate
ucs.description: Hunts the distinctive command-line invocation of the BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) Rust encryptor, which refuses to detonate unless the affiliate supplies the campaign-specific --access-token plus ALPHV's bespoke propagation/VM-kill flags. These argument names are unique to the ALPHV builder and effectively a payload fingerprint.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-snapshot-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| rex field=process "--access-token\s+(?<access_token>[a-fA-F0-9]{32,})"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name access_token process parent_process_name count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                              // drop machine-account noise
| where ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token"
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--no-prop-servers","--no-vm-kill","--no-vm-snapshot-kill","--propagated","--no-prop","--bypass")
| extend AccessToken = extract(@"--access-token\s+([a-fA-F0-9]{32,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)  // ALPHV gate token
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, AccessToken, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| where CommandLine has "--access-token"
   or CommandLine has_any ("--no-prop-servers","--no-vm-kill","--no-vm-snapshot-kill","--propagated","--no-prop","--bypass")
| extend AccessToken = extract(@"--access-token\s+([a-fA-F0-9]{32,})", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, AccessToken, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat/ALPHV Encryptor Access-Token Command Line
id: 7c1f3b2a-9d4e-4f0a-bc11-alphv0001
status: experimental
description: Detects the BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) Rust ransomware encryptor invoked with its unique --access-token credential gate and propagation flags.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|contains: '--access-token'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--no-prop-servers'
      - '--no-vm-kill'
      - '--no-vm-snapshot-kill'
      - '--propagated'
      - '--no-prop'
  condition: selection_token or selection_flags
falsepositives:
  - Extremely rare; no benign software uses this exact flag set
level: critical
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--access-token|--no-prop-servers|--no-vm-kill|--no-vm-snapshot-kill|--propagated/i
| AccessToken := regex("--access-token\\s+(?<AccessToken>[a-fA-F0-9]{32,})", field=CommandLine)
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, AccessToken, CommandLine, SHA256HashData])
ucs.rationale: The --access-token flag (a 32/64-char hex value the affiliate must paste from the ALPHV admin panel) plus ALPHV-specific switches (--no-prop-servers, --no-vm-kill, --no-vm-snapshot-kill, --propagated) are unique to the BlackCat/Noberus Rust builder and not shared by other RaaS families. No legitimate software uses this argument vocabulary, so the detection keys directly on this crew's payload rath
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV pre-encryption recovery inhibition + safeboot reboot cluster
ucs.description: Hunts BlackCat/ALPHV's signature staging sequence that runs just before mass encryption: shadow-copy destruction via vssadmin/wmic combined with bcdedit safeboot/recovery tampering. Requiring two or more distinct recovery-inhibition LOLBins on one host in a 30-minute window separates ALPHV's deliberate teardown from a lone admin's vssadmin call.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count values(Processes.process) as processes min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=30m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| stats dc(process_name) as tool_count values(process_name) as tools values(processes) as cmds min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user
| where tool_count >= 2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
| summarize Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10), ToolCount = dcount(FileName), Tools = make_set(FileName)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where ToolCount >= 2     // >=2 distinct recovery-kill LOLBins = deliberate teardown, not lone admin vssadmin
| order by TimeBucket desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| extend FN = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where (FN =~ "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows")
     or (FN =~ "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (FN =~ "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
| summarize Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10), ToolCount = dcount(FN), Tools = make_set(FN)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, TimeBucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where ToolCount >= 2
| order by TimeBucket desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
| (regex("delete\\s+shadows", field=CommandLine) OR regex("shadowcopy\\s+delete", field=CommandLine) OR CommandLine=/safeboot|recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=toolCount), collect([CommandLine])])
| toolCount >= 2
ucs.rationale: BlackcCat/ALPHV operators characteristically clear shadow copies (vssadmin/wmic) AND tamper with boot recovery — including the distinctive bcdedit safeboot reboot used to encrypt files locked while services run. Backup/admin tooling occasionally touches one of these binaries, but the >=2-distinct-tool-in-30-min correlation isolates ALPHV's deliberate pre-detonation teardown chain rather than benig
